reason: Source review identified missing managed-runtime settlement after a full-assignment model invocation ends or fails. Freeze the regression before changing the path; a process outcome remains distinct from task delivery.

cases.expected: A registered full-assignment model invocation automatically stops its owned native and waiting groups after a terminal result or failure, then settles the Core attempt from actual stop evidence. It cannot leave a stopped assignment marked running.

Nested fixture-test and protected-merge commands do not finish the model worker by themselves. Unknown native, test or merge ownership retains attempt capacity. A failed final host report cannot erase a prior trusted MERGED observation.

A controller restart without original process ownership records uncertainty through the existing lead recovery route and refuses competing work; it never recreates the task database or infers complete stop from missing handles.

scope: Managed invocation lifecycle only. Completion does not fabricate merge, deployment or human acceptance, and protected project-script behavior is unchanged.
